purpose: Prepare AIFundOS for options research and paper-options tracking before a paid provider is connected.
provider_test_plan: Fetch option chains for NVDA, MSFT, AMD, QQQ, and SPY.
Verify bid, ask, last, volume, open interest, implied volatility, and greeks are present.
Check historical option prices for at least 90 trading days.
Calculate spread percentage and reject illiquid contracts.
Compare provider option chain snapshots against Yahoo starter data.
Record sample long call, long put, call debit spread, and put debit spread paper trades.
Track premium P&L, max loss, break-even, expiration, and exit reason.
Review whether options evidence improves or worsens stock setup decisions.

education_terms.delta: How much the option price may move for a $1 move in the stock. Also rough directional exposure.
education_terms.gamma: How quickly delta changes as the stock moves.
education_terms.theta: Estimated daily time decay. Long options usually lose value as time passes.
education_terms.vega: How much the option price may change when implied volatility changes.
education_terms.implied_volatility: The market's embedded expectation for future movement, expressed through option prices.
education_terms.iv_rank: Where current implied volatility sits versus its own recent history.
education_terms.bid_ask_spread: The gap between what buyers bid and sellers ask. Wide spreads increase execution cost.
education_terms.open_interest: Contracts currently open. Higher open interest usually means better liquidity.
education_terms.premium: The option price paid or received.
education_terms.break_even: The stock price needed at expiration to offset the premium paid.
